# from 00_ai_triggers.txt
ai_avoids_radicals = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			always = no
			always = no
		}
	}
}

ai_wants_radicals = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			always = no
			always = no
		}
	}
}

# from 00_coa_triggers.txt
coa_republic_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_presidential_republic
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
	}
}

# from 00_ep2_victoria_scripted_triggers.txt
character_is_valid_for_events = {
   NOT = { has_variable = golpista_var }
   is_adult = yes
}

country_has_isolationism_or_sakoku = {
    has_law = law_type:law_isolationism
}

# from 00_ip5_victoria_scripted_triggers.txt
civil_war_is_valid_for_reforms_at_gunpoint = {
	OR = {
		civil_war_is_liberal_revolution = yes
		civil_war_is_socialist_revolution = yes
	}
	civil_war_progress_high = yes
	political_movement = {
		exists = most_desired_law
		most_desired_law ?= {
			NOT = {
				is_same_law_group_as = law_type:law_council_republic
			}
		}
	}
}

has_hierarchic_ideology = {

}

	has_decree = $DECREE$
}
